# Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans — Plan Price Card

Every Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans tier carries a retail plan price, a discount that applies when the plan is sold on the vehicle's purchase deal, a switch stating whether the plan may be bought on its own, and the fleet volume figures. All prices are in US dollars; discounts are fractions of the retail plan price.

| Plan | Retail plan price (USD) | Discount when sold on the vehicle's purchase deal | May be bought on its own | Fleet volume threshold (active fleet plans, new plan included) | Fleet volume discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | 199.00 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | 0 (no fleet volume discount) | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | 389.00 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | 0 (no fleet volume discount) | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | 549.00 | 0.05 (5 percent) | Yes | 0 (no fleet volume discount) | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | 699.00 | 0.05 (5 percent) | Yes | 0 (no fleet volume discount) | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | 899.00 | 0.10 (10 percent) | No | 0 (no fleet volume discount) | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | 1029.00 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | 10 | 0.08 (8 percent) |

## Reading the card

- **Retail plan price** is the price of the plan before any bundle or fleet volume discount.
- **Discount when sold on the vehicle's purchase deal** is the bundle discount, a fraction of the retail plan price.
- **May be bought on its own** states whether the plan is offered without a vehicle purchase deal. The Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit is the one tier that is not offered on its own.
- **Fleet volume threshold** is the number of the customer's active Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plans, the plan being sold included, at which the fleet volume discount is reached. A threshold of 0 means the tier carries no fleet volume discount.
- **Fleet volume discount** is a fraction of the retail plan price.

## Reference points

- Which tiers carry a bundle discount? Only the Plus and Premium tiers: 5 percent on both Plus plans and 10 percent on the Premium plan. The Essentials and Fleet tiers carry none.
- Which tier has a fleet volume discount? Only the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit, at 8 percent, reached at 10 active fleet plans with the new plan counted.
- Hypothetical illustration of how a fraction reads: a fraction of 0.05 on a hypothetical retail price of 640.00 is 32.00, leaving 608.00. These inputs are invented and are not a plan price.
